components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Violet 8px-cornered button for the one action that moves the flow forward.

components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent,#6752e8);color:#fff;font:550 13px/1.2 var(--font-inter, Inter), Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(27,36,64,.12);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 140ms,background 140ms,box-shadow 140ms}.ds-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:var(--accent-strong,#5541d2);box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(27,36,64,.16)}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px);background:#4937c0;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(27,36,64,.12)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8f80f2;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Secondary and Outline Buttons
components.description: White bordered button with slate text (secondary) and its transparent outline sibling.
components.css: .ds-btn2{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border,#e4e8f1);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:#4b5268;font:550 13px/1.2 var(--font-inter, Inter), Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(27,36,64,.12);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 140ms,background 140ms,border-color 140ms}.ds-btn2.ds-outline{background:transparent;box-shadow:none}.ds-btn2:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:#c2c7d5;background:#f8f8fa}.ds-btn2:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn2:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8f80f2;outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-ideas{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;padding:16px;background:var(--canvas,#f5f7fc)}.ds-idea{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px minmax(0,1fr) 18px;gap:12px;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--border,#e4e8f1);border-radius:9px;background:#fff;color:#81889a;text-align:left;font:400 14px/1.4 var(--font-inter, Inter), Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 140ms,border-color 140ms,background 140ms}.ds-idea:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:#b9b8f4;background:#fcfcff}.ds-idea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8f80f2;outline-offset:3px}.ds-tile{display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:7px;background:#eef3ff;color:var(--accent-blue,#3675ee)}.ds-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}.ds-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.ds-tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.3}.ds-game{color:var(--accent-blue,#3675ee)}.ds-app{color:var(--accent-purple,#7452e8)}.ds-num{color:var(--subtle,#929bb0);font-size:11px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-title{color:var(--ink,#1b2440);font-size:14px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.35}.ds-pitch{color:var(--muted,#68728b);font-size:12px}.ds-chosen{border-color:var(--accent-purple,#7452e8);background:#f4f1ff;color:var(--accent-purple,#7452e8)}.ds-chosen .ds-tile{background:var(--accent-purple,#7452e8);color:#fff}

narrative.overview:
VibeBook is a calm, light study desk for turning a post into something to play or learn from. Every surface is a white card with a hairline border resting on a cool blue-white canvas; one violet accent marks the thing to do next, and two kind colours (blue for games, purple for apps) tell you what an idea will become. The look is clean, quiet and legible rather than playful, so the photo, the ideas and the finished experience carry the colour.

Density is a single reading column (660px, 610px on upload) for the create flow, upload and share page, under a 60px white top bar with the wordmark. The landing widens to a two-column copy-and-preview hero and a two-column how-it-works list, then collapses to one column. Motion is small and functional: 140ms colour and 1px lift transitions on hover, a spinner while something is genuinely loading, and a short slide when the extension overlay opens. The direction is adapted from unslop by Damir Sokolovsky (CC BY 4.0), as credited in the global stylesheet.
keyCharacteristics: One face, Inter, at 400 / 500 / 550 / 600; headings at 500 with tight tracking.
White cards with a 1px cool-grey border on a light blue-white canvas; light mode only.
A single violet accent fills primary buttons, the brand mark, the feed chip and the chosen state.
Blue means game, purple means app, on the idea tile and its tag.
Small, consistent corners (5-12px); circles only for status dots and spinners.
Shadow only on things that press or float: buttons, the landing preview, the chip, the overlay.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only filled colour in the interface. It marks the primary action and the chosen thing; everything else is white with a 1px border.

rules.name: The Kind Colour Rule
rules.body: Blue means GAME and purple means APP. The kind colour sits on the idea's icon tile, and is not used for decoration.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface on web, panel and link-preview card. Weight 600 is reserved for the landing display, the wordmark and the link-preview card; headings elsewhere sit at 500.

rules.name: The Border Defines Rule
rules.body: Containers are separated by a 1px border, not a shadow. A shadow means the element presses or floats above the page.

rules.name: The Tight Radius Rule
rules.body: Corners stay between 5px and 12px and grow with the element. Nothing is fully rounded except status dots and spinners.

dos: **Do** keep every app surface light: Studio Canvas behind, white cards with a 1px Border in front.
**Do** reserve Studio Violet for the primary action, the brand mark, the chip and the chosen state.
**Do** colour ideas by kind: Game Blue for games, App Purple for apps.
**Do** set everything in Inter, with headings at 500 and tight negative tracking.
**Do** use 2px round-stroke SVG icons on a 24px grid in currentColor, and the four-point Spark as the brand's own mark.
**Do** keep hover motion to 140ms colour, border and 1px lift changes, and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: **Don't** add a second typeface or a display face.
**Don't** use pill or fully rounded shapes for buttons, cards or tags.
**Don't** use shadows to separate cards; use the border.
**Don't** fill large areas with violet or use a kind colour where it doesn't mean its kind.
**Don't** set new text in Subtle; it is below 4.5:1 on white.
**Don't** introduce a dark theme; the system is light-only.
